## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the duplicate adoption output so the command reports each existing setting once.

## Changes

Settings plans now include adoption records and an audit record with the incoming setting count. New tests check that the command returns audit records without printing them for single-setting and empty plans.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message once — Running the command with `theme` already present prints `Adopted theme` twice. The planner emits progress immediately, then `app/cli.py:9` prints the returned adoption record because the command skips only audit records. — Command output shows two adoption messages for one existing setting. — Fix: Update the filter at `app/cli.py:7` to skip adoption records the planner has already announced.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_planner.py:20 — tests — Check the audit record without requiring it to come last — For a plan that adds `theme`, placing the audit record before the addition would fail `changes[-1]` even though the command still returns the audit record and prints only `Added theme`. — A record reorder would fail the test while preserving the behavior it is meant to protect.
